packageRules.description: VanillaBP, the Business Cockpit and the BPMS adapters follow the framework, not Renovate: their versions are bumped when a release is cut, and while they are snapshots there is nothing to look up.

The CIB seven version is written by the recipe of the sync, together with the version of the CIB seven adapter, so a change on main would meet the next sync. Camunda is only in the test which runs next to Camunda 7, through the Camunda 7 adapter.
